package dispatch

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// Generator, run once at base 24f0a6ba (no router in the tree):
//   P0A_GOLDEN_OUT=/path/route_p0a_golden.txt go test ./internal/dispatch -run TestGenP0aGolden
func TestGenP0aGolden(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("P0A_GOLDEN_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("generator")
	}
	captureRouteLog(t)
	root := routingRoot(t)
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("# Frozen no-policy routing results, generated once at base 24f0a6ba (P0a chain, no router).\n")
	b.WriteString("# Do not regenerate from the code under test. Inputs: route_matrix_test.go.\n")
	b.WriteString("# key = p<project>|<probe>|<agent>|o<override>; value = runtime|chosen_by|fallback_from|model|model_chosen_by|model_explicit, or ERR <text>\n")
	for pi, yml := range matrixProjects {
		project := projectWithYML(t, yml)
		for _, probe := range matrixProbeNames() {
			withProbe(t, matrixProbes[probe])
			for _, agent := range matrixAgents(t, root) {
				for oi, ov := range matrixOverrides {
					rr, err := routeDispatch(context.Background(), routeInput{
						YakosRoot: root, Project: project, Agent: agent,
						RuntimeOverride: ov.RuntimeOverride, RuntimeEnvDefault: ov.RuntimeEnvDefault,
						RuntimeFallbackOptIn: ov.RuntimeFallbackOptIn, ModelOverride: ov.ModelOverride, EvalRunID: ov.EvalRunID,
					})
					res := "ERR " + fmt.Sprint(err)
					if err == nil {
						res = fmt.Sprintf("%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%v", rr.Runtime, rr.RuntimeChosenBy, rr.FallbackFrom, rr.Model, rr.ModelChosenBy, rr.ModelExplicit)
					}
					res = matrixNorm(res, root, project)
					if strings.Contains(res, root) || strings.Contains(res, project) || strings.Contains(res, os.TempDir()) {
						t.Fatalf("path in row: %s", res)
					}
					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%s\t%s\n", matrixKey(pi, probe, agent, oi), res)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, []byte(b.String()), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
